policy: All observed listed errors have exact-title or source-aware terminology corrections. All records remain needs-human-review; unreviewed domain terminology may still be inaccurate.

descriptionReview.action: Limit translated short descriptions to the first official sentence (at most 600 source characters); full source remains in descriptionEn. Added exact-excerpt glossary corrections for observed title/description ambiguities.
